$comment: Traffic, commercial and plant. Same rules as the hero cars: no badge, wordmark or fleet name ever,
prohibitions live in negative_prompt, and the silhouette carries recognition.
WHAT IS DIFFERENT IS FRAMING. flux's framing prior does not move for words, and most of this
roster is either very long (semis, trailers, buses) or very tall (excavators, combines, tractors).
Wide subjects frame themselves, so long vehicles are asked for in a 1344x768 frame and tall ones
in 768x1344. That is the only lever that has ever worked on the crop.
Trailers are drawn WITHOUT a tractor and plant WITHOUT its attachment, so they compose in-game.
